INNER JOIN [News.Categories] AS [n0] ON [n].[CategoryID] = [n0].[ID]
LEFT JOIN [News.Categories] AS [n1] ON [b].[CategoryID] = [n1].[ID]
WHERE [b].[Key] = @__key_0
ORDER BY [b0].[Order]
